headline: Approved additional audit services contracts with CBIZ and CliftonLarsonAllen, both unanimously.
summary: Before taking up the orders, the Council met in executive session with attorneys about attorney-client communications. The Finance Committee sent the CliftonLarsonAllen order to the Council without a recommendation, and the Council referred it to the Committee of the Whole for review.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL 
SPECIAL MEETING INCLUDING 
COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE 
 
8:00 PM, AUGUST 13, 2026 
MINUTES DRAFT 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Present - Bob Anthony, Min. Leader 
 Present - Sean Cardwell, Pro Tem 
Present - Rhonda Caldwell 
 Absent -Maurine Crouch 
Preset - Tom Figlar, Min. Whip 
Present - Doug Foley 
 Present - Sarah Gallagher, Maj. Leader 
Present -Tasha Hunt, Maj. Whip 
Absent - Abdul Osmanu 
Absent - Tameeka Parks 
Absent - Ted Stevens 
Present - Grace Teodosio 
Present - Adrian Webber 
Present - Katie Kiely, President 
    
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Legislative Council Special Meeting, August 13, 2026.  The meeting was called to order 
at 8:04pm with the members noted above in attendance.  Council members Crouch, 
Osmanu, Parks, and Stevens were absent. 
  
2. PUBLIC COMMENT SESSION 
The Public Input session was opened at 8:10pm.  Two members of the public gave public 
comment, after which the Public Input session was closed at 8:15pm.  There was one item 
of public input received in writing.    
3. SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA  
  A. Council President Report  
Council President Kiely provided an overview of the materials before the Council. 
 
B. Finance Committee Transmittal, without recommendation: 
President Kiely called for a motion to accept the Finance Committee transmittal of the 
Order Authorizing the Additional Services Consulting Agreement with 
CliftonLarsonAllen (CLA).  
Motion: Gallagher 
Second: Figlar  
Vote: 11 in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Motion passed unanimously. 
  
  C. Referral of the "CLA Order" to the Committee of the Whole 
President Kiely referred the Order Authorizing the Additional Services Consulting 
Agreement with CliftonLarsonAllen (CLA) to the Committee of the Whole for 
consideration, noting that the referral would allow Council Members to review the
information and ask questions before the item returned to the Legislative Council for 
final consideration. President Kiely then called for a motion to recess to the Committee 
of the Whole.  
  D. Recess to Convene Committee of the Whole 
Motion to recess: Gallagher 
Second: Foley  
    
4. Committee of the Whole   
  1. Call to Order/Taking of the Roll  
President Kiely called the Committee of the Whole to order at 8:21pm and took roll. The 
following members were present: Council members Alston, Anthony, Cardwell, 
Caldwell, Crouch, Figlar, Foley, Hunt, Gallagher, Hunt, Teodosio, Webber and Kiely. 
  2. Public Input 
The Public Input session was opened at 8:21pm.  2 members of the public provided 
input.  Public Input was closed at 8:26pm.  There were no items of written 
correspondence.  
  
  3. SPECIAL LC COMMITTEE MEETING AGENDA: DELIBERATION AND ACTION  
 
i). Executive Session, if necessary  
President Kiely announced the members would be going into Executive Session to discuss 
attorney/client communications.  In addition to the Council members, attorney Mednick and 
attorney Gruen participated.   
 
Motion to go into Executive Session: Foley 
Second: Alston  
Vote: 10 in favor, 1 opposed (Teodosio) and 0 abstentions.   
 
Executive Session began at 8:32pm. 
 
Motion to come out of Executive Session: Figlar 
Second: Gallagher 
Executive Session ended at 9:19pm. 
 
President Kiely noted that the Council would consider two orders related to the audit 
process: an amendment to expand the scope of services for the Town's auditor CBiz, and 
an additional services agreement with CliftonLarsonAllen 
 
ii). Order Authorizing Additional Municipal Audit Services with Marcum LLP d/b/a 
CBIZ CPA's for municipal audit related services 
 
Kyle Connors, Managing Director of CBiz provided a brief overview of the work they are 
doing, after which, Council members asked questions. After discussion, President Kiely 
called for the vote. 
 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Item passed unanimously.  
 
iii). Order Authorizing Additional Services Consulting Agreement with Clifton Larson 
Allen LLP
Motion to open the item for discussion: Gallagher 
Second: Foley  
 
Finance Director Hul explained the proposed contract amendment and how it would impact 
CLA's scope of work.  With no questions or comments, President Kiely called for the vote. 
 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  The item passed unanimously. 
 
iv).  Adjourn Committee of the Whole 
Motion to come out of Committee of the Whole: Anthony 
 
The Committee of the Whole adjourned at 10:34pm 
 
5. Resumption of the Special Meeting Agenda   
  1. Receipt of the Report of the Committee of the Whole 
Motion to receive the report from the Committee of the Whole: Gallagher 
Second: Foley 
  
  2. Order to Approve the Updated PY52 Annual Action Plan and Submit such documents 
to HUD and to Authorize the Mayor to Accept and Expend Community Development 
Block Grant Funds 
 
The motion to open item 7.2: Foley 
Second: Gallagher 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  
   
ADJOURNMENT 
Motion to adjourn: Teodosio 
Second: Anthony    
 
The meeting adjourned at approximately 10:36pm.
